en-US.landing.title: Build your longest path view
en-US.landing.body: Add the required fields to start analyzing your schedule.

values.landing.title: Build your longest path view
values.landing.body: Add the required fields to start analyzing your schedule.

dataRoles.name: taskId
dataRoles.description: Unique identifier for each task. When Aphex fields are bound, enable Show items with no data on this field to retain P6 activities without linked subtasks.

dataRoles.name: duration
dataRoles.description: Task duration; optional in No Calculation mode because it can be calculated from start and finish dates

dataRoles.name: taskTotalFloat
dataRoles.description: Bind per-activity Total Float in days for Float-Based classification; activities need a finite value to enter Critical or Near-Critical results

dataRoles.name: taskFreeFloat
dataRoles.description: Free float value for each task

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: Calculated or Actual/Forecast start date

dataRoles.name: finishDate
dataRoles.description: Calculated or Actual/Forecast finish date

dataRoles.name: manualStartDate
dataRoles.description: User-defined start date for visualization (does not affect calculation)

dataRoles.name: manualFinishDate
dataRoles.description: User-defined finish date for visualization (does not affect calculation)

dataRoles.name: baselineStartDate
dataRoles.description: Baseline start date

dataRoles.name: baselineFinishDate
dataRoles.description: Baseline finish date

dataRoles.name: previousUpdateStartDate
dataRoles.description: Previous update start date

dataRoles.name: previousUpdateFinishDate
dataRoles.description: Previous update finish date

dataRoles.name: dataDate
dataRoles.description: Status date of the schedule

dataRoles.name: taskName
dataRoles.description: Name of the task

dataRoles.name: taskType
dataRoles.description: Type of task (TT_Task, TT_Rsrc, TT_Mile, TT_FinMile)

dataRoles.name: predecessorId
dataRoles.description: ID of predecessor task

dataRoles.name: relationshipType
dataRoles.description: Relationship type (FS, SS, FF, SF)

dataRoles.name: relationshipLag
dataRoles.description: Lag or lead time for relationship

dataRoles.name: relationshipFreeFloat
dataRoles.description: Used for Longest Path. The lowest finite incoming value per successor and ties are driving; negative values are retained. Rows without finite values are excluded when other usable values exist.

dataRoles.name: tooltip
dataRoles.description: Additional fields for tooltips

dataRoles.name: legend
dataRoles.description: Categorical field to color tasks

dataRoles.name: wbsLevels
dataRoles.description: Work Breakdown Structure hierarchy levels

dataRoles.name: extraColumns
dataRoles.description: Additional fields rendered as label columns between the task name and date columns

dataRoles.name: aphexExternalId
dataRoles.description: P6 activity ID stored as the Aphex external_id reference

dataRoles.name: aphexTaskId
dataRoles.description: Stable identifier for each Aphex subtask

dataRoles.name: aphexParentTaskId
dataRoles.description: Optional structural parent identifier within the same Aphex External ID; this is not a predecessor relationship

dataRoles.name: aphexTaskName
dataRoles.description: Display name of the Aphex subtask

dataRoles.name: aphexStartDate
dataRoles.description: Planned start date of the Aphex subtask

dataRoles.name: aphexFinishDate
dataRoles.description: Planned finish date of the Aphex subtask

dataRoles.name: aphexSortOrder
dataRoles.description: Optional explicit sequence for Aphex subtasks

dataRoles.name: aphexDetails
dataRoles.description: Optional repeatable Aphex detail fields such as status, owner, crew or progress

headerLegendControlBackgroundColor.displayName: Header and Legend Control Background Color

bandColor.description: Start + Finish mode only: band colour when Start and Finish variance are effectively unchanged

includeWbsGroups.description: Include visible WBS summary rows. Points use the group envelope: earliest displayed start and latest displayed finish. Each group counts as one summary row

showAnalysisLegend.description: Start + Finish mode only: when header space permits, show counts for complete paired display rows where Finish variance improved, worsened or was effectively unchanged. Counts can include WBS summary rows when enabled

longestPathDisplayMode.description: Deprecated compatibility property retained for existing reports. It is ignored; Longest Path always shows the full driving network.

displayScope.description: Choose which rows show enabled comparison bars. Without active WBS grouping, task rows are always used.

verticalOrder.description: Choose the top-to-bottom order of Current, Previous Update, and Baseline bars.

baselineColor.displayName: Baseline Bar and Finish Line Color

baselineOffset.description: Additional vertical separation between Baseline and its adjacent enabled lane.

previousUpdateColor.displayName: Previous Bar and Finish Line Color

previousUpdateOffset.description: Additional vertical separation between Current and Previous Update.

showPanel.description: Allow Aphex subtasks below a selected P6 activity or across every visible P6 parent at the terminal hierarchy depth

showParentLinks.description: Show structural Aphex parent-child branches when Aphex Parent Task ID is bound; these are not predecessor relationships

expandOnSelection.description: Retained for compatibility with saved reports; Show Inline Breakdown now controls selection expansion

autoOpen.description: Retained for compatibility with older reports; selecting a matched P6 activity now reveals its inline Aphex subtasks

barColor.description: Fill colour for expanded Aphex subtask bars; a contrast outline is added when needed

rowBackgroundColor.description: Colour used to tint expanded Aphex subtask rows

rowBackgroundTransparency.description: Controls the selected row colour: 0% is solid and 100% is transparent

comparisonMode.description: Compare P6 Early Start/Finish with the earliest Aphex Start and latest Aphex Finish for each P6 activity and visible WBS summary. WBS rows use a solid P6 Early reference and dashed Aphex envelope; every active mode fits the full visible P6 and comparable Aphex timeline

deviationThresholdDays.description: Directional filters use a strict greater-than comparison; 0 includes every non-zero deviation

comparisonColor.description: Colour for task and WBS comparison references, Aphex outlines, endpoint cues, warnings, and the Aphex finish line

timelineScale.description: Controls inline Aphex rows and the Aphex finish-marker scope; active P6 comparisons fit their combined P6 and Aphex timeline. Explicit manual zoom remains in effect with off-screen cues

showParentEnvelope.description: Show the selected P6 activity extent behind its Aphex subtasks

showBaselineDateColumns.displayName: Show Baseline Columns When Bars Are Off

showPreviousUpdateDateColumns.displayName: Show Previous Columns When Bars Are Off

labelText.description: Text shown before the date; blank uses Finish

labelColor.description: Used exactly as selected when Automatic Text Colour is off

automaticLabelColor.description: Keep the selected text colour when readable; otherwise use black or white for contrast with the label background

labelText.description: Text shown before the date; blank uses Baseline

labelColor.description: Used exactly as selected when Automatic Text Colour is off

automaticLabelColor.description: Keep the selected text colour when readable; otherwise use black or white for contrast with the label background

labelText.description: Text shown before the date; blank uses Previous

labelColor.description: Used exactly as selected when Automatic Text Colour is off

automaticLabelColor.description: Keep the selected text colour when readable; otherwise use black or white for contrast with the label background

show.description: Display the latest valid finish for the selected P6 activity when it has linked Aphex data; otherwise use linked Aphex data across the current filtered P6 scope. This marker is independent of inline subtask visibility

labelText.description: Text shown before the date; blank uses Aphex Finish

automaticLabelColor.description: Keep the selected text colour when readable; otherwise use black or white for contrast with the label background

labelColor.description: Used exactly as selected when Automatic Text Colour is off

labelText.description: Text shown before the date; blank uses Data Date

automaticLabelColor.description: Keep the selected text colour when readable; otherwise use black or white for contrast with the label background

labelColor.description: Used exactly as selected when Automatic Text Colour is off

selectedPathIndex.description: Deprecated compatibility property retained for existing reports. It is ignored because individual route selection is no longer available.

showPathInfo.description: Deprecated compatibility property retained for existing reports. It is ignored because individual route information is no longer displayed.
